primary.endpoint_units: percent_inhibition for threshold 70; normalized_activity for threshold 0.7

primary_gene_weighting: equal genes; equal assay weights within gene

cohort.note: holdout studies share no molecule with checkpoint training (upstream Hu.csv) or the Huesken development cohort; upstream evaluation exposure is disclosed (weight-independent, not fully independent)

baseline_selection: strongest development-selected comparator, chosen on the Huesken cohort only
acceptance: >=0.10 paired Top-5 precision gain, paired gene-bootstrap 95% CI above zero, no completion loss, positive budget-yield change
notes: Numerical success alone never sets independent_validation_passed; the cohort gate must also pass.
Never overwrite the freeze lock or re-choose a holdout after its labels are read.
Development and holdout never share a molecule; the audit is molecule-level, not gene-level.
